variants.label: 均衡蓝青
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, COLOR CHANGE ONLY.
Select as the edit target the earlier supplied printer with the DARK NAVY GLASS SCREEN, TWO GLOWING PALE VERTICAL EYES AND GLOWING CURVED SMILE. The other image with a pale face panel and black dot eyes is a rejected edit: IGNORE it completely.

Make ONE change only: shift the printer's mint/turquoise OUTER ENCLOSURE to BLUE-CYAN, around #42B8D5 on the front and #278EB1 on the shaded right side. Preserve the existing illumination, highlights, gradients and material. The hue should be a little bluer and less green, still clearly cyan-blue rather than deep cobalt. Recolor the folded paper corner accent consistently.

LOCK THE ENTIRE FACE: keep the original dark navy glass screen, its reflections, both glowing pale vertical rounded-rectangle eyes, and the glowing curved smiling mouth exactly as in the dark-screen source. Do not change the face panel color, eye shape, eye size, spacing, glow, mouth or facial expression. Do not use dot eyes, black facial features or a pale display. Face changes are forbidden.
Also preserve the exact rounded printer silhouette, camera angle, proportions, top paper and three grey bars, top input opening, front narrow output slot, yellow button, white indicator, two dark low feet, framing, glossy 3D appearance and transparent background. Do not add any part or redesign anything. No new paper sheet, arms, text, backdrop, floor, cast shadow or watermark.
Return one color-edited version of the original DARK-SCREEN icon on transparent RGBA.
variants.input_mode: conversation reference images; original dark-screen image selected
